# Bundled plugin catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_plugins.sh. Do not edit manually. -->

These plugins are built and verified as part of every lla release.

- [`activity_history`](../../plugins/activity_history/README.md) — Add Git-backed file activity history to timeline listings (`dev.lla.activity-history`)
- [`brew`](../../plugins/brew/README.md) — Manage Homebrew packages (`dev.lla.brew`)
- [`categorizer`](../../plugins/categorizer/README.md) — Categorize files from extensions and metadata (`dev.lla.categorizer`)
- [`change_risk`](../../plugins/change_risk/README.md) — Estimate per-file change risk from size, complexity, Git churn, and worktree state (`dev.lla.change-risk`)
- [`code_complexity`](../../plugins/code_complexity/README.md) — Analyze source-code complexity (`dev.lla.code-complexity`)
- [`code_snippet_extractor`](../../plugins/code_snippet_extractor/README.md) — Extract and manage tagged code snippets (`dev.lla.code-snippet-extractor`)
- [`dirs_meta`](../../plugins/dirs_meta/README.md) — Calculate directory counts and sizes (`dev.lla.dirs-meta`)
- [`duplicate_file_detector`](../../plugins/duplicate_file_detector/README.md) — Detect files with identical content (`dev.lla.duplicate-file-detector`)
- [`file_copier`](../../plugins/file_copier/README.md) — Interactively copy files and directories (`dev.lla.file-copier`)
- [`file_hash`](../../plugins/file_hash/README.md) — Calculate file hashes (`dev.lla.file-hash`)
- [`file_meta`](../../plugins/file_meta/README.md) — Expose detailed filesystem metadata (`dev.lla.file-meta`)
- [`file_mover`](../../plugins/file_mover/README.md) — Interactively move files and directories (`dev.lla.file-mover`)
- [`file_organizer`](../../plugins/file_organizer/README.md) — Organize files using configurable strategies (`dev.lla.file-organizer`)
- [`file_remover`](../../plugins/file_remover/README.md) — Interactively trash files by default with explicit permanent deletion (`dev.lla.file-remover`)
- [`file_tagger`](../../plugins/file_tagger/README.md) — Attach and query user-defined file tags (`dev.lla.file-tagger`)
- [`flush_dns`](../../plugins/flush_dns/README.md) — Flush the operating system DNS cache (`dev.lla.flush-dns`)
- [`folder_cleaner`](../../plugins/folder_cleaner/README.md) — Plan, quarantine and restore generated-folder cleanup (`dev.lla.folder-cleaner`)
- [`git_status`](../../plugins/git_status/README.md) — Expose repository and per-entry Git status (`dev.lla.git-status`)
- [`google_meet`](../../plugins/google_meet/README.md) — Create and manage Google Meet links (`dev.lla.google-meet`)
- [`google_search`](../../plugins/google_search/README.md) — Search Google with suggestions and history (`dev.lla.google-search`)
- [`hackernews`](../../plugins/hackernews/README.md) — Browse Hacker News stories and discussions (`dev.lla.hackernews`)
- [`jwt`](../../plugins/jwt/README.md) — Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (`dev.lla.jwt`)
- [`keyword_search`](../../plugins/keyword_search/README.md) — Search selected file contents for keywords (`dev.lla.keyword-search`)
- [`kill_process`](../../plugins/kill_process/README.md) — Inspect and terminate operating-system processes (`dev.lla.kill-process`)
- [`last_git_commit`](../../plugins/last_git_commit/README.md) — Expose the last Git commit for each entry (`dev.lla.last-git-commit`)
- [`media_inspector`](../../plugins/media_inspector/README.md) — Inspect MIME, dimensions, EXIF, duration, codecs, and bitrate (`dev.lla.media-inspector`)
- [`npm`](../../plugins/npm/README.md) — Search npm packages and inspect bundle size (`dev.lla.npm`)
- [`preview`](../../plugins/preview/README.md) — Preview source text, Markdown, images, and archives in the terminal (`dev.lla.preview`)
- [`project_context`](../../plugins/project_context/README.md) — Detect project type, toolchains, dependency locks, artifacts, and repository health (`dev.lla.project-context`)
- [`reclaimable_space`](../../plugins/reclaimable_space/README.md) — Identify generated, cached, and temporary files that can be reclaimed (`dev.lla.reclaimable-space`)
- [`remove_paywall`](../../plugins/remove_paywall/README.md) — Create archival and reader links for URLs (`dev.lla.remove-paywall`)
- [`security_audit`](../../plugins/security_audit/README.md) — Audit unsafe permissions, privileged bits, risky symlinks, and exposed secrets (`dev.lla.security-audit`)
- [`sizeviz`](../../plugins/sizeviz/README.md) — Visualize file sizes (`dev.lla.sizeviz`)
- [`speed_test`](../../plugins/speed_test/README.md) — Measure network latency and throughput (`dev.lla.speed-test`)
- [`trash`](../../plugins/trash/README.md) — Cross-platform recoverable deletion with restore support (`dev.lla.trash`)
- [`tree_summary`](../../plugins/tree_summary/README.md) — Add recursive directory totals to tree listings (`dev.lla.tree-summary`)
- [`youtube`](../../plugins/youtube/README.md) — Search and open YouTube videos (`dev.lla.youtube`)
